v4-review.rubric: Adversarially review the Archive editorial-100x diff. Treat the prior redesign baseline (warm-neutral palette, BeanDetailCard trading-card + manual-FLIP hero morph, useBeanDetail, Rotation/Inventory) as APPROVED — only judge this change. FAIL if any of the three inversions remain: the ★ rating is not visibly led on each entry (R1), the trading-card back still shows a dead "· N" tastings count instead of the full tasting (stars + aroma/body/finish + notes) (R2), or the layout is still a uniform card list with no size hierarchy / featured treatment (R4, R5). FAIL if the per-row "Show Details" expander or per-row flavor-tag chips survive (R3). FAIL if favourite cups are not kept on top or the rest is not chronological + year-grouped, or year headers do not pin (R5). FAIL if a pull-quote renders empty when a bean has no tasting note (must degrade) (R1). FAIL if tapping an entry does not open BeanDetailCard via the morph (R7). FAIL if motion is not transform/opacity-only, exceeds 300ms (non-spring), uses bounce > 0.3, or is not gated by reduced-motion (parallax/reveal/morph must all disable) (R6). FAIL if search or any filter (year, min-rating, roaster, origin, process, sort) regressed or stops filtering cups + timeline, or an empty state was dropped (R8). FAIL if gold/accent is used beyond the rating + one active state (must stay ≤10% / scarce), or hairline grouping / tabular-nums on counts regressed. FAIL if the BeanDetailCard changes are not additive (Rotation/Inventory regress), or the diff touches Firebase reads/writes, the bean/tasting data model, statuses, or restore/delete logic. PASS only when the tasting is the visible hero, the redundant disclosure is gone, the layout has real editorial hierarchy with cups-on-top + chronological, motion is tasteful + gated, and the diff is scope- and design-clean.

v5-human.prompt: On the dev app (device): open Archive and confirm the layout now feels Apple-caliber, not slop — each entry leads with its rating + your words (pull-quote), favourite cups sit on top with the rest chronological, year headers pin as you scroll, and bags/entries animate in tastefully; tap an entry and confirm the bag flies into the trading card and the back shows your full tasting (stars + aroma/body/finish + notes); confirm "Show Details" and the row flavor-tags are gone; run a search and a filter — proving R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8 and the overall feel.

goal.definition_of_done: Every archive entry (featured cup + timeline row) leads with its ★ rating + one-word + a tasting pull-quote (degrading gracefully when a bean has no tasting); the trading-card back shows the full tasting per session (stars + aroma/body/finish + notes), not a dead count; the per-row "Show Details" expander and flavor-tag chips are gone; favourite cups stay highlighted on top (editorial featured treatment, lead cup emphasized) with the rest chronological + year-grouped and year headers that pin while their section scrolls; tapping any entry flies the bag into BeanDetailCard via the hero morph; motion (scroll-reveal stagger, parallax bags, spring + haptics) is transform/opacity-only and reduced-motion disables parallax/reveal + the morph; search and every filter still filter both the cups and the timeline and the empty states remain; no Firebase/data/logic/API is touched and no feature is lost; `npx vite build` exits 0; the Archive Playwright harness shows rating + pull-quote per entry, NO Show-Details control and NO row flavor-tag chips, featured cups before a chronological timeline, a working tap→morph, search filtering, reduced-motion with no flight, and zero console errors; verify-inventory and verify-morph still PASS; codex review is clean against the rubric; and Tal signs off on device that the Archive now feels Apple-caliber and the tasting is the visible star.
goal.statement: 100x the Archive layout so it reads Apple-caliber, not slop: make the TASTING the hero of every entry (★ rating + one-word + a pull-quote from the note), keep Tal's structure (favourite cups highlighted on top, the rest chronological), and add iOS-native motion (scroll-reveal stagger, parallax bag thumbnails, spring + haptics, pinning year headers) on top of the existing hero morph. Declutter the redundant "Show Details" expander and row flavor-tag chips, and surface the full tasting (stars + aroma/body/finish + notes) on the trading-card back instead of a dead "· N" count. Visual/UX only; no Firebase or feature changes; dev channel only.

scope_guard: Do NOT change Firebase reads/writes, the bean/tasting data model, statuses, or restore/delete/finish logic (presentation only; read tasting fields, never write).
Do NOT make non-additive BeanDetailCard changes — the full-tasting panel must reuse the existing tastings prop and not regress Rotation/Inventory.
Do NOT change WHAT Archive shows (FINISHED beans) or which actions exist (Restore, Delete, Learn, Edit, brew-profile, tastings) — only how they look and are triggered.
Do NOT build the deferred "time machine / what were you sipping" throwback module in this loop (fast-follow).
Do NOT animate any non-transform/opacity property, exceed 300ms (non-spring) / bounce 0.3, or skip the reduced-motion gate; do not deploy to production or merge to main (dev channel only).
